policy_evidence.heading: Member Eligibility and Plan Status
policy_evidence.quote:
Benefits are payable only if the member is enrolled and the Plan is active on the date of service.
If the member’s Plan is inactive at the time services are rendered, the claim will be denied.
Denial reason: “Plan inactive at time of service.”

policy_evidence.heading: Duplicate Claims
policy_evidence.quote:
A claim is considered duplicate if all of the following match:
 Member ID
 Provider NPI
 Date of service
 CPT / procedure code
 Billed amount
Duplicate claims will be denied with reason: “Duplicate claim submission.”

policy_evidence.heading: Exclusions
policy_evidence.quote: 5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted

policy_evidence.heading: Coding Consistency
policy_evidence.quote:
Claims may be routed for coding review if diagnosis and procedure codes are clinically inconsistent
based on standard coding guidelines.

policy_evidence.heading: Non-Covered Imaging
Overview of Covered Benefits
policy_evidence.quote:
This Policy provides coverage for Medically Necessary services that are not otherwise excluded.
Covered Benefits include, but are not limited to:
 Physician office visits and specialist consultations
 Diagnostic imaging (e.g., ultrasound, CT, MRI)
 Outpatient procedures
 Emergency services
 Prescription drugs (Formulary-based)
Coverage is subject to member eligibility, cost-sharing, Prior Authorization requirements, and all
limitations in this Policy.

policy_evidence.heading: Medical Necessity Standard
Services Requiring Prior Authorization
policy_evidence.quote:
The following services require Prior Authorization:
 MRI (all anatomical regions)
 CT scans (except emergency)
 Elective inpatient admissions
 Durable medical equipment (DME) exceeding $500
 Specialty drugs listed as “PA Required” on the Formulary
Claims for these services performed without approval may be denied unless retroactive authorization
is granted.

policy_evidence.heading: Exclusions
policy_evidence.quote:
The Plan does not cover:
1. Cosmetic or reconstructive procedures not required by trauma or congenital anomaly
2. Services deemed not Medically Necessary
3. Experimental or investigational treatments
4. Services for which required Prior Authorization was not obtained
5. Duplicate claims for the same service date and provider, unless corrected and resubmitted
